path.title: Concept and design
path.body: We are specifying the food, beer, place and brand, and preparing real tests.
path.needs: Nothing to prove yet. This stage is about being precise.

path.title: Testing, tastings and pop-ups
path.body: Cooking the first dishes, talking to future guests, and running small events.
path.needs: Permits understood, a kitchen, a partner brewery where beer is involved, and thresholds set before we start.

path.title: A small mobile kitchen or a brewery residency, if validated
path.body: A way to serve people regularly and learn from real orders.
path.needs: Evidence that people come back, and a clear legal path for any beer.

path.title: NASHA brewery and kitchen
path.body: A permanent place with visible brewing, a full kitchen and a shaded court.
path.needs: A site, professionals, capital, and everything above working.

method: Only real events are published as events.
Every entry says what was tested, what happened, and what we change next.
Nothing is staged and nothing is backdated.
Recipes and supplier terms stay private; lessons do not.
